narrative.en: Architect of Lynx at ByteDance — the open-source, dual-threaded UI stack behind TikTok, Douyin, and CapCut. Building cross-platform native UI from web skills, and asking what app frameworks look like in the age of AI.
narrative.zh: 字节跳动 Lynx 架构师——支撑 TikTok、抖音、CapCut 的开源双线程 UI 技术栈。用 Web 技能交付跨平台原生界面，并追问 AI 时代的应用框架该长成什么样。

keywords.zh: 跨平台, React, 性能优化

narrative.en: From RIT's programming languages lab to Meta's React org. Built Hermes for iOS, co-founded React Forget as tech lead of the auto-memoization compiler, and shipped to billions through React Native.
narrative.zh: 从 RIT 编程语言实验室到 Meta React 团队。将 Hermes 引入 iOS，作为 React Forget 自动记忆化编译器的联合创始工程师及技术负责人，通过 React Native 服务数十亿用户。

keywords.zh: React, 编译器, JavaScript 引擎

narrative.en: From a CUC student building first web apps to leading mobile web teams. Consulted on China's first influential PWA at Ele.me, championed Progressive Web Apps through conference talks across China.
narrative.zh: 从中国传媒大学学生构建第一个网页应用到领导移动端 Web 团队。为饿了么中国首个有影响力的 PWA 提供咨询，在全国各大会议上推广 Progressive Web Apps。

keywords.zh: PWA, 移动端 Web, Service Worker

description.en: Co-leading Lynx architecture and developer experience in ByteDance's Web Infra Cross Platform team.
description.zh: 在字节跳动 Web Infra 跨平台团队共同领导 Lynx 架构与开发者体验工作。

description.en: React Technologies team — Hermes JS engine, React Forget compiler (founding eng + tech lead).
description.zh: React Technologies 团队 —— Hermes JS 引擎、React Forget 编译器（联合创始工程师 + 技术负责人）。

description.en: Summer internship at Meta Reality Labs Research, working on XROS — an experimental operating system for XR.
description.zh: Meta Reality Labs Research 暑期实习，参与面向 XR 的实验性操作系统 XROS。

description.en: Summer internship at Meta on the ReasonML / ReScript team, working on Messenger Web.
description.zh: Meta ReasonML / ReScript 团队暑期实习，参与 Messenger Web 的开发。

description.en: Master's in Computer Science at Rochester Institute of Technology, focusing on programming languages under Prof. Matthew Fluet.
description.zh: 在罗切斯特理工学院攻读计算机科学硕士，师从 Matthew Fluet 教授，专注编程语言方向。

description.en: Short consulting engagement that produced China's first widely cited Progressive Web App.
description.zh: 短期顾问合作，做出中国首个被广泛引用的 Progressive Web App。

title.zh: Web 基础架构团队主管

description.en: Founding engineer of Yupiaoer. Founded the Web Infra team. Led the company-wide tech stack migration to React.
description.zh: 娱票儿创始工程师。组建 Web 基础架构团队。主导全公司技术栈向 React 的迁移。

description.en: Front-end engineer on the Alitrip mobile web team, working across Taobao / Alitrip hybrid app patterns.
description.zh: 阿里旅行移动端 Web 前端工程师，参与淘宝 / 阿里旅行 Hybrid App 架构。

title.zh: 数字媒体艺术 学士

description.en: Bachelor's in Digital Media Art at Communication University of China.
description.zh: 在中国传媒大学攻读数字媒体艺术本科学位。

title.en: Lynx: Making ByteDance Beat Across Platforms

description.en: As client-side products mature and fragment, cross-platform has become the default choice for many developers and companies. Yet UI-framework innovation is converging, cross-platform approaches look increasingly alike, and the market is settling into a fixed shape. Against this backdrop, why did Lynx — the cross-platform technology ByteDance nurtured for years — decide to go open source? This talk lifts the veil on Lynx and explores the insights and future of cross-platform together.
description.zh: 伴随终端业务的成熟和碎片化，跨端已成为众多开发者和企业的首选。但同时，UI 框架的创新在收敛，跨端思路大同小异，市场格局趋于固化。在这个背景下，字节孕育多年的跨端技术 —— Lynx，为何决定走向开源？本演讲将揭开 Lynx 的“神秘面纱”，与你一同探寻跨端的洞见与未来。

conference.name: 第 19 届 D2 终端技术大会

description.en: Lynx, a new cross-platform stack adopted by the TikTok app that empowers teams to ship truly native UIs to mobile and web from a single codebase using their existing web skills like CSS and React, has recently been open sourced. In this talk, we'll explore what makes Lynx familiar and what sets it apart from other cross-platform technologies; we'll take a closer look at its dual-threaded design, and how that enables Lynx's instant launches and silky-smooth interactions, plus a sneak peek at what's next for Lynx.
description.zh: Lynx 是 TikTok 应用采用的全新跨平台技术栈，让团队用 CSS、React 等既有的 Web 技能，从同一套代码交付面向移动端与 Web 的真正原生 UI，并已于近期开源。本次演讲将探讨 Lynx 为何既熟悉又与众不同，深入其双线程架构，看它如何带来瞬时启动与丝滑交互，并预告 Lynx 的下一步。

description.en: TikTok's production UI framework: write JavaScript and CSS, render native primitives, and split work across two threads so launch is instant and gestures stay on the UI thread. A sibling to the React Summit talk, for a broader industry audience.
description.zh: TikTok 的生产级 UI 框架：用 JavaScript 和 CSS 写出原生控件，并把工作拆到两条线程上——启动要瞬间完成，手势要留在 UI 线程。和 React Summit 那一场是姊妹篇，面向更广的行业听众。

description.en: For over a decade, we've lived in a universe where programming UIs with React on the client-side, from event handling to rendering, has been ruled by a single JavaScript thread. But what if React had been born differently? What if, from day one, it had been designed to fully embrace two threads? What benefits would that unlock? What challenges would we face? And what new features, abstractions, and patterns might emerge? What if this isn't just imagination... but something that exists today?
description.zh: 十多年来，我们身处这样一个宇宙：在客户端用 React 编写 UI，从事件处理到渲染，始终由单一 JavaScript 线程主宰。但如果 React 生来不同呢？如果从第一天起，它就被设计为彻底拥抱两个线程呢？这会解锁哪些收益？我们又会面临什么挑战？会涌现出哪些新特性、抽象与范式？而这一切如果不只是想象，而是今天已然存在的现实呢？

description.en: A companion interview at React Universe Conf, going behind the scenes of React for Two Threads and Lynx's dual-threaded design.
description.zh: React Universe 大会的配套访谈，聊聊《为双线程而生的 React》与 Lynx 双线程设计的台前幕后。

description.en: Ready-to-use components are vital to delivering user interfaces with velocity and scale. Introducing lynx-ui, the newest member of the Lynx family of cross-platform technologies behind TikTok. By taking advantage of Lynx's dual-threaded architecture, it offers high performance and native-graded interactivity. Join us to learn how we built it, and how it unlocks Lynx to scale across a massive range of products, even faster.
description.zh: 开箱即用的组件对于高速、规模化地交付用户界面至关重要。让我们隆重介绍 lynx-ui —— TikTok 背后 Lynx 跨平台技术家族的最新成员。借助 Lynx 的双线程架构，它带来高性能与原生级的交互体验。一起来了解我们如何构建它，以及它如何让 Lynx 更快地扩展到海量产品之中。

description.en: A panel discussion at React Advanced London on the promise and reality of cross-platform UI — writing once and rendering natively everywhere.
description.zh: React Advanced London 上的圆桌讨论，探讨跨平台 UI 的愿景与现实——一次编写，在各端原生渲染。

title.en: Frontend is Dead, Long Live Frontend

description.en: Year-end keynote on the same thread as FEDAY: frontend as a job title may be fading; frontend as a way of building interfaces is not.
description.zh: 年度主题演讲，和 FEDAY 同一条线索：作为岗位的「前端」或许在消退，作为构建界面方式的前端不会。

description.en: Is frontend dead, or is it just being renamed? A personal map of the big-frontend inflection points — and a guess at what AI and XR ask of the next generation of UI engineers. Inspired by Qi Lu's talk on large models.
description.zh: 前端已死，又或是前端未来？当我们在说前端时，我们又在说什么？受陆奇博士大模型演讲启发，梳理大前端演化的几个拐点，并对下一世代（AI、XR…）的前端做一点猜想。

description.en: Open-source cross-platform UI framework behind TikTok, Douyin, and CapCut. Familiar React and CSS, native rendering, dual-threaded architecture — instant launch and main-thread interactivity. Open-sourced in March 2025.
description.zh: 支撑 TikTok、抖音、CapCut 的开源跨平台 UI 框架。熟悉的 React 与 CSS、原生渲染、双线程架构——瞬时启动与主线程交互。2025 年 3 月开源。

commentary.en: Not a better React Native. The bet is that web skills plus a two-thread runtime can unlock native — for more platforms, more products, more people.
commentary.zh: 不是更好的 React Native。赌注是：Web 技能加上双线程运行时，能把原生能力解锁给更多平台、更多产品、更多人。

description.en: Named one of 33 China Open Source Pioneers by SegmentFault.
description.zh: 被 SegmentFault 评选为中国开源先锋 33 人之一。

description.en: State of React — React 18, what the core team was solving next (including the compiler), and how developers in China can take part.
description.zh: React 现状与方向：React 18、核心团队接下来在解决的问题（包括编译器），以及中国开发者如何参与。

description.en: Featured as a cover story on Gitee.
description.zh: 被 Gitee 评为封面人物。

description.en: First public look at React Forget — an auto-memoizing compiler so you can write React without memo, useMemo, or useCallback. The research that later shipped as React Compiler.
description.zh: 首次公开 React Forget：一个自动记忆化编译器，让你写 React 时不必再手写 memo / useMemo / useCallback。后来以 React Compiler 之名落地。

description.en: JavaScript engine optimized for React Native, built by the Programming Language & Runtime (PL&R) team. Led the effort to bring Hermes to iOS.
description.zh: 由 Programming Language & Runtime（PL&R）团队打造，为 React Native 优化的 JavaScript 引擎。主导将 Hermes 引入 iOS 的工作。

description.en: Founding engineer of the React Compiler (formerly Forget), the auto-memoization compiler that reshapes React's authoring model.
description.zh: React Compiler（原名 Forget）的联合创始工程师 —— 重塑 React 编写模型的自动记忆化编译器。

commentary.en: The authoring model should stay clean. If memoization is load-bearing, a compiler should do it — so React can be fast by default. We called it Forget; it shipped as React Compiler.
commentary.zh: 编写模型就该是干净的。如果记忆化是刚需，那就该由编译器来做——让 React 默认就很快。我们当时叫它 Forget，后来以 React Compiler 落地。

description.en: Summer 2019 internship. My manager framed it as: "As part of Reality Labs Research (formerly Oculus Research), I led a research team building a new programming language and application framework specifically targeting all-day wearable, low power devices."
description.zh: 2019 年暑期实习。我的主管这样描述这个项目：「作为 Reality Labs Research（原 Oculus Research）的一部分，我带领研究团队，为全天可穿戴、低功耗设备构建一门新的编程语言和应用框架。」

description.en: Contributor on the ReasonML team — an OCaml-syntax typed-JS toolchain that was later rebranded as ReScript. Worked on Messenger Web during the summer 2018 internship.
description.zh: 参与 ReasonML 团队 —— 基于 OCaml 语法的类型化 JavaScript 工具链，后更名为 ReScript。2018 年暑期实习期间参与 Messenger Web 开发。

description.en: A practical guide to upgrading existing web applications to Progressive Web Apps. The YouTube recording is no longer available; the slides are still playable here, and the conference page remains reachable via the Wayback Machine.
description.zh: 将现有网页应用升级为渐进式 Web 应用的实用指南。YouTube 上的演讲录像已下线；幻灯片仍可在此直接播放，会议官网则可通过 Wayback Machine 访问。

description.en: Guided the Ele.me PWA upgrade, pioneering PWA techniques for Vue-based multi-page apps. Featured by web.dev and highlighted at Google I/O 2017 — China's first widely cited Progressive Web App.
description.zh: 指导饿了么的 PWA 升级，把 PWA 技术用在基于 Vue 的多页应用上。被 web.dev 收录，并在 Google I/O 2017 上被点名——中国首个被广泛引用的 Progressive Web App。

description.en: Award-winning ticket-buying app. Founding engineer; also founded the Web Infra team and led the company-wide tech stack migration to React.
description.zh: 获奖购票应用「娱票儿」。创始工程师，同时组建 Web 基础架构团队并主导全公司技术栈向 React 的迁移。

commentary.en: 要做一个有 swag 的程序员. The theme was the first thing a lot of people knew me for — before compilers, before Lynx.
commentary.zh: 要做一个有 swag 的程序员。在编译器、在 Lynx 之前，很多人是先从这套主题认识我的。

description.en: An internal WePiao talk that escaped the building. Seven days from design patterns to ES6 modules — script loaders, CommonJS, AMD/CMD, Browserify/Webpack. The Weibo thread hit 100k reads.
description.zh: 微影内部的一次分享，流传了出去。从设计模式讲到 ES6 Module，七天走完 script loader、CommonJS、AMD/CMD、Browserify/Webpack。微博转发后阅读到了 10 万。

title.zh: 都 2015 年了，CSS 怎么还是这么糟糕

description.en: A tour of how we got from OOCSS and BEM to CSS Modules — and POCss, a pragmatic proposal: scope styles to components, let pages override them.
description.zh: 从 OOCSS、BEM 讲到 CSS Modules，并提出 POCss：组件样式要隔离，页面再合理地覆盖。

title.en: Progressive Web App, in my points of view

description.en: Installability, the app shell, offline, service workers, re-engagement — and the cons, honestly. An early field note from the year before Ele.me's PWA.
description.zh: 可安装、App Shell、离线、Service Worker、再参与——以及诚实的缺点。饿了么 PWA 之前一年的田野笔记。

description.en: Introducing Progressive Web Apps to the Chinese developer community.
description.zh: 关于 Native 与 Web 的纷争，从 Web 诞生之日起到现在就从未消停过。眼看这场战火在移动时代的方寸之间愈演愈烈，有的人坚定地站在了 Native 阵营，有的人则选择 Open Web 作为自己的信仰。近年来，随着融合与相互借鉴的声音成为主流，Hybrid、动态化与基于 Web 开发范式的跨平台解决方案百花齐放，而 Google Chrome 团队，也联合 Microsoft Edge、Mozilla Firefox、Opera 等一众浏览器厂商，给出了来自 Web 阵营的回应——Progressive Web App，向 Native 阵营吹响了反击的号角……
